text: FIX the relaxed selector syntax of the database viewer kept backslash escapes like `\n`, `\\` and `\u0041` literally inside single quoted strings, so `{ name: { $regex: '^\\d+$' } }` matched different documents than the same selector with double quotes. Single quoted strings now resolve the JSON escapes and `\'`. Any other backslash, like in `{ name: { $regex: '\d+' } }`, stays a literal backslash
